## ✅ Quality & Contribution Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please check that:

- [ ] My code adheres to the [Contribution Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] **Strict file limit**: No modified or created file exceeds **250 lines** of code.
- [ ] Static type check passes cleanly: `go vet ./...` (0 errors/warnings).
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass: `go test -v -race ./...`.
- [ ] Formatted with standard Go formatter: `go fmt ./...`.
- [ ] Zero unnecessary external dependencies added (stdlib first).

- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if applicable.
